hook.text: In 2008, Iron Man launched a cinematic universe that would dominate a decade of box offices.

buildup.text: Marvel proved that interconnected stories across films could keep audiences coming back.

discovery.text: The MCU model generated over $29 billion — the most profitable franchise in film history.

twist.text: Critics worry that superhero saturation is crowding out every other kind of film.

climax.text: The debate continues: are cinematic universes the future or a creative dead end?

punchline.text: One genre conquered the entire industry.

quiz.question: What film launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
